title: test(cli): the #30120 start-refusal cases carry the spawn's own timeout
body:
Fixes #37601

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了命令行工具的一个集成测试,产品行为前后不变。
- 为什么做:这组「镜像开关打开、缺设置就拒绝启动」的测试在繁忙的 CI 机器上偶发超时,已把两个无关的合并请求踢出合并队列。
- 出错会怎样:最坏只是这几条测试的超时上限变长,真正失败仍会报红;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

`packages/cli/test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` only.

- The three cases of `#30120 — with the image switch on, a start missing its settings refuses` each wait on one synchronous `os start` (`spawnSync`, 120 s allowance) but ran under vitest's 5 s case default. Each now carries `SPAWN_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS` as its case timeout.
- The spawn allowance and the case timeout are one file-level pair, `SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000` and `SPAWN_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS = SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS + 10_000`, hoisted from the `#31600` describe (where they were `SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS` / `LEG_TIMEOUT_MS`) so both spawning describes read the same values and cannot drift. The literal `timeout: 120_000` in the `refuse()` helper now reads `SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS`.
- No assertion changes; nothing skipped, retried or quarantined; the global vitest timeout is untouched.

Shape search: every `spawnSync` in the file (two: the `#30120` refusal helper and the `#31600` leg helper) and every `it(` was listed. The `#31600` cases already carried the spawn bound. The two boot describes (`explicit file:` and `without the switch`) spawn only in `beforeAll`, which already carries `BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS + 30_000` / `+ 60_000`, and their cases only read the recorded result. No other describe has the shape.

## Tests

Run on head `ca1c021a`, after the `@objectstack/cli...` build closure (70/70 turbo tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0).

<details><summary>vitest --project integration on this file: 11/11 pass</summary>

```
✓ #30120 refusal > none set: exit 1, naming all three, before anything is written 1567ms
✓ #30120 refusal > only the database missing: names only OS_DATABASE_URL 1606ms
✓ #30120 refusal > a switch value that is not a switch is refused too, rather than read as off 1588ms
✓ #31600 > OS_AUTH_SECRET unset 1704ms / set 3003ms / CONTROL 3667ms
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  11 passed (11)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```

Each refusal case reads about 1.6 s on a shared local box; the card's runner readings went past 5 s under load.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Test-only diff: `packages/cli` ships `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; the edited file is under `test/`, so nothing publishes and the PR carries `skip-changeset`.

## Verification

Read first: the `#30120` refusal describe (the three new case timeouts) and the hoisted constants beside `BOOT_TIMEOUT_MS`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/start-deployment-durability.integration.test.ts` after building the CLI; expect 11 passed.
